setup: You start with $\frac{[[a_num]]}{[[a_den]]}$ of a cake and give away $\frac{[[b_num]]}{[[b_den]]}$ of it.

steps.say: Both amounts are parts of the same cake, so measure them against a common whole: LCM([[a_den]], [[b_den]]) = [[lcm]].
That is $\frac{[[a_scaled]]}{[[lcm]]}$ had and $\frac{[[b_scaled]]}{[[lcm]]}$ given away.
Take the smaller from the larger: [[a_scaled]] − [[b_scaled]] = [[raw_num]], out of [[raw_den]].

answer: So $\frac{[[raw_num]]}{[[raw_den]]}$ of the cake is left — in lowest terms, $\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}$.
